sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil, collapsing the entire expression to nothing
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any one person is gone, the whole path to them dissolves into nothing.

sketches.mechanism: In Lua, table indices start at 1, and accessing index 0 returns nil — the zeroth position simply does not exist
sketches.resonance: Before the beginning, there is nothing; existence only starts at one.
sketches.draft:
local life = {}
life[1] = true
life[2] = true
life[3] = true

local before_the_beginning = life[0]
-- nil

sketches.mechanism: The discard keyword in a fragment shader destroys the current fragment, preventing it from being written — the pixel simply never appears
sketches.resonance: Some moments, upon closer inspection, choose not to exist — they quietly remove themselves from the picture.
